architecture.mechanism: thermal runaway propagation mitigation via separator reinforcement and fire prevention strategies
architecture.intervention: integrate a thermally stable, mechanically reinforced separator (e.g., ceramic-coated or aramid-fiber composite) between pouch cells to prevent local collapse during fast charging (3C), combined with a passive fire barrier (e.g., intumescent coating) between modules to contain thermal propagation
architecture.expected_effect: reduced separator collapse under mechanical stress during fast charge, localized containment of thermal runaway, and <8% energy density loss due to minimal added mass
architecture.falsification_test: subject reinforced-separator packs to 3C fast charge (10-80% in 20 min) under mechanical compression (1.5x nominal pressure) and verify no separator collapse or propagation to adjacent cells via thermal imaging and post-mortem analysis; compare energy density pre/post-modification
